response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, deep hands-on coding skills across multiple languages, and a proven track record in distributed systems and open-source tooling, but lacks explicit evidence of building enterprise-scale experimentation or growth platforms, feature-flagging systems, or AI-driven measurement frameworks — key requirements for this role.
strengths: Extensive production experience with distributed systems and high-throughput services (e.g., millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
Strong technical leadership demonstrated through open-source contributions, workshops, and cross-team mentoring
Proficient in multiple languages including Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, and DLang — aligning with required tech stack
concerns: No clear evidence of designing or shipping experimentation platforms, feature flags, or growth measurement systems
Limited visibility into statistical analysis, bias detection, or risk controls in experimentation workflows
AI tool usage for engineering velocity is mentioned vaguely (AI-agent infrastructure) without measurable impact
